publications.title: Semantic Signal-Assisted Inspection and Recovery Allocation in Reverse Logistics
publications.summary: Using return notes to guide inspection depth and recovery allocation when asset condition is uncertain and inspection labor is limited. Evaluated in three synthetic reverse-logistics scenarios.

publications.title: When Does an Added Planning Capability Create Operational Value? An Observable Evidence Standard
publications.summary: An evidence standard for assessing whether an added planning capability changes executed plans and improves operational outcomes, evaluated through forecast-to-plan replay on retail datasets.

publications.title: Policy-Bounded, Provenance-Aware Deployment Assurance for LLM Request Routing
publications.summary: Research on policy boundaries, evidence provenance, and deployment assurance for routing requests to large language models.

publications.title: DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains
publications.summary: Ranking supply-chain interventions by recoverable net value, using a controlled synthetic benchmark with causal ground truth and explicit intervention costs, delays, and uncertainty.

publications.title: Accuracy-Preserving Stability Regularization for Large-Scale Retail Demand Forecasting
publications.summary: Training-time regularization for steadier retail demand forecasts while preserving point accuracy, evaluated on selected M5 demand series at multiple scales.
